plus.analyst_notes:
Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/24667
Victim: Sony Network Communications Inc. (SNC, Sony Group ISP; So-net). NAICS refined from 517 to 517311 (2017 Wired Telecommunications Carriers, which includes fixed broadband ISPs; matches the corpus's 2017 coding). Employee count 1001 to 10000 is approximate and not confirmed against a fetched source in this pass (web lookups were rate-limited); please verify.
Secondary victim: NTT Docomo (comment on the issue). plala (S course) is a plan NTT Docomo offers to Docomo Hikari customers; SNC is Docomo's contractor and the plala (S course) data (443,495 records) sat in SNC's So-net member database. Listed as 'NTT Docomo, Inc.; 517312'. Not a Partner_Breach-labelled issue and SNC is itself the main data owner (2.14M So-net members), so SNC is primary as the issue states; hacking vector left Unknown rather than Partner because the attack vector into SNC is undisclosed - reviewer may add Partner to reflect the Docomo relationship.
Template Hacking-ext-unknown: hacking variety Unknown (cause under investigation). Deviation: asset S - Database instead of S - Web application, because sources describe unauthorized access to the So-net member database/server, not a web app; vector Unknown instead of Web application for the same reason.
Data: 2,585,481 member records (So-net 2,141,986 incl. members who left since March 2026; plala S course 443,495): names, phone, email, user ID, birth date, gender, internet-connection ID -> Personal (amount/data_total 2,585,481). 54,401 email addresses with passwords for four So-net mail services (Mail Service G, A-Box, So-net VAIO Mail, PostPet) -> Credentials 54,401 (the issue body's 'Gmail' is a mistranslation of Mail Service (G)). 16 So-net records with bank details (institution, branch, account type/number, holder) -> Bank 16. General member passwords, card data and PINs not leaked. data_disclosure Yes (SNC says leakage confirmed). data_victim Customer. No secondary harm confirmed as of Oct 27, so data_abuse not coded.
Timeline: unauthorized access Oct 19, 2026; SNC confirmed it and shut down the server Oct 23; items/counts identified Oct 24; Docomo informed Oct 26; disclosure and forced mail-password reset Oct 27. Discovery internal Unknown (4 days). Containment Days. dbir_year 2027. Actor external Unknown; motive Unknown.
Sources: Yahoo (issue), BleepingComputer (comment; fetch failed but kept), innovaTopia (fetched, primary detail source).
Confidence Medium: action variety unknown.

event_chain.summary: Member data copied from So-net member database

summary: A third party gained unauthorized access to Sony Network Communications' So-net member database on October 19, 2026. SNC confirmed the intrusion and shut down the server on October 23 and disclosed on October 27 that 2,585,481 member records were leaked - 2,141,986 So-net members and 443,495 members of NTT Docomo's plala (S course) service whose data SNC held as Docomo's contractor - including names, phone numbers, email addresses, user IDs, dates of birth, gender and internet-connection IDs, plus 54,401 email-service passwords (force-reset) and bank account details for 16 members. The attack method is under investigation.
